responsibility: This file implements the post-reload GCSE-style pass that removes redundant loads introduced after register allocation, especially by reload. It builds a hash table of available memory expressions from loads and stores, optionally computes per-block memory transparency, searches for fully or partially redundant inter-block loads whose redundancy can be exposed by inserting compensating loads or register copies on predecessor edges, marks the original loads for deletion, and finally deletes the redundant insns. Its responsibility is late load redundancy cleanup after reload, distinct from the more general pre-reload GCSE framework.
